Appearance

Portly, jovial halfling with a mischievous twinkle in his eye. Classroom full of curious items that shift and change form.

What We Know

Professor of Transmutation at the Highreach Wizard's Tower. Hands-on teacher who encourages creativity and experimentation. Legendary love for ale and good food.

First Impressions

Warm and mischievous — the kind of professor who makes you forget you're in a lecture.
